nausicaa.name: Nausicaá
nausicaa.slogan: Ten million litres of ocean, a short walk from the fish quay.
nausicaa.line: Opened in 1991, Nausicaá is the largest public aquarium in Europe, with a 10,000,000-litre tank built for manta rays.

capblancnez.name: Cap Blanc-Nez
capblancnez.slogan: White chalk, wind and England on the horizon.
capblancnez.line: In the 18th century this cape was a key point of the Anglo-French Survey linking the Paris and Greenwich observatories.

vimy.name: Vimy Memorial
vimy.slogan: Two white pylons and 11,000 names on a quiet ridge.
vimy.line: An inspired expression in stone, chiselled by a skilful Canadian hand, of Canada's salute to her fallen sons.
vimy.by: King Edward VIII, unveiling of the Vimy Memorial, 26 July 1936

arrasgrandplace.name: Arras Grand Place
arrasgrandplace.slogan: Arcades, gables and a belfry rebuilt brick by brick.
arrasgrandplace.line: 155 Flemish-Baroque townhouses surround Arras's two squares; built in wood, they were rebuilt in brick after World War I.

basiliqueboulogne.name: Boulogne Basilica
basiliqueboulogne.slogan: A dome over the old town, a crypt beneath it.
basiliqueboulogne.line: Its crypt, one of the largest in France, mixes Roman, Romanesque and Gothic work under a dome over 100 metres high.
